Professor Review: Nemati is bad at communication and does not always answer questions clearly. However he is nice and receptive to emails, usually answering within 24 hrs or less. The problem sets questions are sometime vague or unclear which may cause you may misinterpret the wording incorrectly and lose points. He does give points back if you email why you believe you’re correct. He calls on you if he knows your name in class. If you struggle with hearing, he does have a bit of an accent that may make it difficult to hear. The TA grading may vary in this class so it is important to advocate for yourself to make sure you’re not losing points where you shouldn’t be.
Survival Tips: Grading is very particular about wording so make sure to use the suggested wording to phrase your answers (this is on the slides and in the book). Go to class consistently because attendance is counted and is only counted based on answering correctly on poll everywhere quizzes. You will have an easier experience with the coding portion of the class if you have a Windows computer. MACs can vary with some people having problems. Chromebooks need additional extensions which can be a hassle. It helps to be familiar with Python or coding before but everything is taught to be beginner friendly. Try to complete homework early to avoid rushing and allow yourself time to ask questions.
